ValidationRule.description: FL4. Fields required from stage 2: the three qualification criteria, Grade, Segment.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Stage_Order__c > 2, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Qualification_Goal__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Qualification_Budget__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Qualification_Timing__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Grade__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Segment__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To move past Qualification in chat, fill in the three qualification criteria (goal, budget, timing), the grade and the segment.
